matcher.method: multi-scale shift-invariant inner-mask BLAS template matching with soft hero-class collection prior, Hungarian unique identity assignment, and collection node stat icon ROI detection
matcher.uncalibrated_score: Lower matcher MSE is a closer template match; it is not a probability.

limitations: Detector thresholds were tuned against the known pilot layouts.
Ground-truth box evaluation uses one-to-one box matching at the configured IoU threshold.

Team assembly uses layout-specific spatial grouping, Hungarian unique assignment for heroes and pets, soft hero-class prior (0.80x) for collections, and ROI template matching for collection node stat icons.
